200.title: Polish PM warns of possibility of more serious Russian attacks in Poland
200.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has said the coming weeks and months will see very intense Russian activity and that more serious attacks on Polish territory cannot be ruled out. The meeting follows Russian attacks in the immediate vicinity of Poland on the night of 12-13 September and on the morning of 13 September.
200.body: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has said the coming weeks and months will see very intense Russian activity and that more serious attacks on Polish territory cannot be ruled out. The meeting follows Russian attacks in the immediate vicinity of Poland on the night of 12-13 September and on the morning of 13 September. Background: Dariusz Sinecki, spokesperson for the Nadbużański Border Guard Unit in Poland, said that a drone hit a lorry near the Yahodyn-Dorohusk border crossing on the night of 12-13 September. Earlier, Andrii Demchenko, spokesperson for Ukraine's State Border Guard Service, said that the Yahodyn border crossing itself on the border with Poland had not been hit.

300.body: Siemens Mobility is building the first railway service centre in Poland September 14, 2026 Siemens Mobility is expanding its European rail service network by building a new, state-of-the-art service centre in Gądki, near Poznań, Poland. 400.title: Skyborn Renewables seals funding for German offshore wind project
400.summary: Skyborn Renewables has reached financial close on the up to 976.5MW Gennaker offshore wind farm in Germany’s Baltic Sea, unlocking more than €3bn ($3.47bn) of investment for the country’s largest project in the region. “With all key project components now in place, we are entering construction with confidence and a clear focus on successful execution,” said Patrick Lammers, CEO of Skyborn Renewables.
400.body: Skyborn Renewables has reached financial close on the up to 976.5MW Gennaker offshore wind farm in Germany’s Baltic Sea, unlocking more than €3bn ($3.47bn) of investment for the country’s largest project in the region. All major project agreements are now effective, including debt and equity arrangements, power purchase agreements, strategic partnerships, and supply and installation contracts. The wind farm is expected to provide enough electricity for around 1m German households and support jobs and supply-chain activity in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. “With all key project components now in place, we are entering construction with confidence and a clear focus on successful execution,” said Patrick Lammers, CEO of Skyborn Renewables.

400.title: Masdar sets sights on major German offshore wind expansion
400.summary: Abu Dhabi-based renewable energy company Masdar has signed two memoranda of understanding with German companies for potential investments of over €8bn ($9.24bn) in offshore wind and battery energy storage. Under one agreement, German utility RWE and Masdar agreed to consider joint participation in German offshore wind auctions in 2027.
400.body: Abu Dhabi-based renewable energy company Masdar has signed two memoranda of understanding with German companies for potential investments of over €8bn ($9.24bn) in offshore wind and battery energy storage. Under one agreement, German utility RWE and Masdar agreed to consider joint participation in German offshore wind auctions in 2027. In September 2022, the companies signed a MoU to explore collaboration on offshore wind projects in key global markets, which subsequently led to Masdar becoming RWE’s The two are partners in the Dogger Bank South offshore wind project, which has an overall capacity of 3GW. The second agreement will see Masdar and German energy infrastructure asset manager Luxcara explore a strategic partnership covering investments in battery energy storage systems (BESS), offshore wind, and potentially other technologies across Germany and Europe.
